title: A Better Way to Learn with AI
subtitle: 更聪明地使用 AI 学习
paragraphs: An AI assistant can explain a difficult idea in several ways. But a reliable answer should still agree with the evidence. A confident voice alone does not prove that an answer is correct.

When I study a new word, I ask the assistant for a short example first. Then I close the explanation and try to retain the meaning. If I cannot remember it, I ask for a different example instead of reading the same answer again.

This habit helps me adapt my practice to the problem. Sometimes I need a clearer sentence. Sometimes I need to compare two similar words. The capacity to learn grows through small steps, rather than one long lesson.
The content we enjoy can influence our attention. I like technology, so examples about useful tools keep me interested. Yet the final test is simple: can I understand the word in a new sentence?
paragraphTranslations: AI 助手能用不同方式解释一个难懂的概念。不过，可靠的回答仍应与证据一致。仅仅语气自信，不能证明回答正确。
学习新词时，我先请助手给出一个简短例句。然后关闭解释，尝试记住它的意思。如果想不起来，我会要一个不同的例句，而不是反复读同一个答案。
这个习惯帮助我根据问题调整练习。有时需要更清楚的句子，有时需要比较两个相似的词。学习能力通过小步骤提高，而不是靠一次很长的学习。
我们喜欢的内容会影响注意力。我喜欢技术，所以与实用工具有关的例子能让我保持兴趣。不过，最终的检验很简单：换一个句子，我还能理解这个词吗？

choices: Tries to recall the meaning without looking.

title: One Bird, One Small Experiment
subtitle: 一次观鸟摄影的小实验
paragraphs: On a weekend trip, I tried to photograph a small bird near a river. The memory card had enough capacity for hundreds of pictures, but most of my first photos were not clear.
I needed a reliable way to improve. Instead of changing every camera setting at once, I changed only one setting and kept notes. The pictures became evidence of what worked and what did not.

Light and movement both influence a photograph. When the bird moved into the shade, I had to adapt my settings. I began to retain more of what I learned because each idea was connected to a real picture.
At the end of the trip, my best photo was not perfect. Still, I understood why it was better. A small experiment had taught me more than taking many pictures without thinking.
paragraphTranslations: 周末旅行时，我试着拍摄河边的一只小鸟。存储卡的容量足够存下数百张照片，但最初的大多数照片都不清楚。
我需要一种可靠的改进方法。我没有一次改变所有相机设置，而是只改一项并做记录。照片成为了证据，告诉我什么方法有效、什么无效。
光线和运动都会影响照片。小鸟进入阴影时，我不得不调整设置。我开始记住更多学到的知识，因为每个想法都与一张真实照片联系在一起。
旅行结束时，最好的一张照片仍不完美。但我明白它为什么更好。一次小实验，比不加思考地拍很多照片让我学到更多。

questions.question: Why did the writer change only one camera setting at a time?
choices: To identify what helped the photo improve.
questions.explanation: 每次只调整一个变量，更容易从照片中判断哪项调整有效。

content:
On a weekend trip, I tried to photograph a small bird near a river. The memory card had enough capacity for hundreds of pictures, but most of my first photos were not clear.

I needed a reliable way to improve. Instead of changing every camera setting at once, I changed only one setting and kept notes. The pictures became evidence of what worked and what did not.

Light and movement both influence a photograph. When the bird moved into the shade, I had to adapt my settings. I began to retain more of what I learned because each idea was connected to a real picture.

At the end of the trip, my best photo was not perfect. Still, I understood why it was better. A small experiment had taught me more than taking many pictures without thinking.

我需要一种可靠的改进方法。我没有一次改变所有相机设置，而是只改一项并做记录。照片成为了证据，告诉我什么方法有效、什么无效。

光线和运动都会影响照片。小鸟进入阴影时，我不得不调整设置。我开始记住更多学到的知识，因为每个想法都与一张真实照片联系在一起。
